answer: To book a berth at a cargo jetty, an agent needs vouches from three distinct clusters of the trust graph, and one cluster counts once however many vouches it sends. If 2,000 fakes posing as a garden supply co-op vouch for each other, they fill one slot. Each still needs two outside backers, who lose vouching rights if it is flagged. So the clique's weight stays at its nadir: 2,000 accounts count as one. Slowly infiltrating real clusters remains a gap.
